_comment: SINGLE configuration file for the cluster pipeline (scripts 47, 48, 49, 46).
Edit the paths block to match your cluster, then every script reads it with
--config configs/cluster.json. Command-line flags override individual values.
results_dir must be a PERSISTENT directory. Large artefacts (samples.jsonl,
checkpoints, figures) are written there and are excluded from git by
outputs/* in .gitignore - keep results_dir inside outputs/ or outside the repo.
Nothing here is a model architecture setting. Architecture comes from each
checkpoint's own stored flow_config, read by scripts/47_cluster_preflight.py.
sampling_seed is the BASE seed. Script 48 uses base + 1000*repetition +
target_position; script 46 uses base + run. Both are deterministic, so a
repetitions are SAMPLING repetitions of ONE trained checkpoint. They are not
independently trained seeds and must never be reported as such.
